panels.general_description: Vertical flowchart of boxed text from the patient description through differential diagnosis, labs and imaging to working diagnosis and management.
panels.detailed_description: Black-and-white vertical flowchart of rectangular text boxes joined by downward arrows with small gray labels. Top box reads "22-year-old man, known case of post-traumatic encephalocele and previous pneumococcal meningitis episode". Arrow labeled "Presented with" leads to "Fever and signs of increased intracranial pressure (e.g., headache, vomiting, irritability), associated with upper respiratory tract infection signs (e.g., rhinorrhea, cough)". Arrow labeled "Physical examination" leads to "Positive nuchal rigidity". Arrow labeled "Differential diagnosis" leads to a box listing "1. Meningitis", "2. Subarachnoid hemorrhage", "3. Space-occupying lesion (eg, brain abscess)". The chart then splits into a left branch labeled "Labs" and a right branch labeled "Imaging studies". Left box: "> Blood culture and blood tests" and "> Lumbar puncture followed by CSF analysis and culture"; arrow labeled "Results" leads to a box listing "> Leukocytosis", "> High CSF protein", "> Low CSF glucose", "> Low CSF : serum glucose ratio", "> Positive blood and CSF cultures for pneumococci". Right box: "Brain imaging (CT and MRI without and with contrasts)" leading to a box listing "> Meningeal enhancement", "> Ring-enhancing lesion", "> Presence of encephalocele". Both branches merge into a box reading "Subarachnoid hemorrhage ruled out due to absence of", "> Subarachnoid space enhancement", "> Xanthochromia in CSF analysis". Arrow labeled "Working diagnosis" leads to "Recurrent pneumococcal meningitis, complicated by brain abscess". Arrow labeled "Management" leads to the final box listing "> Admit for IV antibiotics and steroids", "> Investigate for immunodeficiency (e.g., HIV test, immunoglobulins)", "> Consult neurosurgery and otolaryngology for encephalocele and abscess management".

limitations: Categorical flowchart text only; no printed numeric measurements.
